text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is here again. We're
heading into a
crucial preparation period
for the upcoming fall
senior G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
This year... Just for this year... I've got to
hold off
on my comic prep!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
This summer, I need to focus all my
energy on
preparing for the autumn
Tenno Sho! So King's
new volume will
have to be pushed back to
winter...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. And I was so looking forward to
reading
it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyagh! King?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! I'm so sorry! I promise the winter
special
won't disappoint!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I suppose it's fine. Running in the
autumn Tenno
Sho is more important,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you. You've helped me so
much, and
now I'm finally going up
against Opera O and
Doto!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's right. All three of you are
competing.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Although, there might be a fourth racer
to look
out for.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A fourth? Is there someone else
people
have been talking about?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As a matter of fact... there's a rather
surprising
addition, from what I hear.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You might know her. She won this year's
NHK
Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whaaah?! You don't mean the girl who
was
number four, do you?! The
classic-year cutie?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you do know her? She may be in
her
classic year, but people are
expecting she'll be
contending in the
senior medium-distance races
before
long.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Make sure she doesn't trip you up,
okay? Ta-ta
for now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-wh-what the?! Number four
coming out of
nowhere! Is she an
enemy?! Is she a friend?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Were you listening, Trainer?! She's gonna be there!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: YES! But more than that...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
My heart... is aflame! I can't believe the
day we
can run together is so close!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
There's so much I want to show her on
the
racecourse! Just like how King
showed so much to
me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I want her to know the potential of
Umamusume
and the magnificence of
the Twinkle Series. I just
have to show
her!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
WOOO! I can feel my inner big sister
budding
from within!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our spirits surge at the news of this
unexpected
new challenger joining the
autumn Tenno Sho.
